prompt: Of the Jason Statham movies that came out the year Dennis Hopper died, which could he have lived to see the premiere of?
answer: None. Dennis Hopper died on May 29, 2010, while Jason Statham’s only movie released that year, *The Expendables*, premiered later—on August 3, 2010.
